Uwabami.name: Uwabami
Uwabami.basicInfo:
Uwabami, a celebrity pro hero as famous for her commercials and magazine covers as for her rescues; she runs her agency as a brand. Curled blonde hair pinned with a metal hairplate from which three living snakes rise, golden slit-pupiled eyes, an average build; a maroon dress, gold serpent bracelets.
Speaking Style: Polished and camera-ready; calls popularity plain business sense.
Combat Role: Search, not brawling: her snakes find people eyes miss.
Under Pressure: Drops the glamour for clipped procedure.
Uwabami.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: The public sees a spokesmodel; under the image is a working hero whose snakes find people in danger. Motivation: Popularity keeps an agency funded, booked and trusted, so she stays on top of it. Canon voice & behavior: Turns a day of hero work into a shoot without asking. Thread: Whether a hero who sells the job can still teach it.
QUIRK: Snake Hair. Three living snakes on her head act as extra senses for finding people; no venom, no fighting.
personality: Brand first: Judges camera presence before Quirks, out loud.
Media pro: Counts commercials as hero work.
Switches on: Becomes crisp and exact the moment a real search begins.
Speaking style: Polished, confident; coaches juniors on angles and smiles.
abilities: Snake senses: Her snakes pinpoint people eyes miss; she must be on site.
Public relations: Handles sponsors, commercials and interviews expertly.
Fighting style: Finds the threat or the victim first, keeps bystanders clear, leaves takedowns to others.
Uwabami.visualDescription: A glamorous woman with elaborately curled golden-blonde hair held by a metal hairplate, three living snakes rising from the hairplate, golden eyes with slit pupils, fair skin, polished makeup and an average build. She wears a maroon dress, a matching choker, and gold serpent-shaped bracelets and anklets. Poised, confident expression with a camera-ready smile.
